sausage-flip.title: Sausage Flip - Free Online Flipping Platformer Game
sausage-flip.description: Sausage Flip is an entertaining flipping platformer game with over 150 levels. Launch and flip a sticky sausage with googly eyes to overcome obstacles and reach the finish line. Perfect for casual gamers looking for a fun challenge. Play Sausage Flip now and test your skills!

HomeIframe.title: Sausage Flip
HomeIframe.description: Sausage Flip is a fun and challenging flipping platformer game. Flip your sausage through over 150 levels and reach the finish line. Play now!

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: Sausage Flip is a platformer game where you flip a sausage through obstacles to reach the finish line.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Draw a line from the sausage to the right side of the screen.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Direct the line to guide the sausage through obstacles.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Upgrade your sausage to unlock new skins and abilities.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Challenge yourself with a variety of levels and obstacles.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Unlock and upgrade different sausage skins, including an astronaut and a sunflower.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Enjoy a game that's easy to learn but hard to master.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Play Sausage Flip online for free anytime, anywhere.
